scenario_description:
Objective: Turn a brief visiting-mentor opening into optional credential-readiness feedback on a prepared portfolio question set.
Emerging Need: A possible office-hour visit has no usable channel or confirmed focus at first; later an authenticated mentor contact, freed evening window, posted portfolio slot, and booking code make participation feasible.
Decision Context: The stored learner record and office-hour preference note determine whether the announced topic matches existing materials and whether using the verified address is appropriate.
Consequence: A seat could sharpen future certification planning; letting the roster close leaves coursework, attendance, requirements, and scores exactly as they were.

parameter.subject: Possible visiting mentor office hours next week
parameter.body: A court-certified visiting mentor may offer a small optional office-hours block next week. The topic, contact route, and booking code are still pending; the activity will not carry attendance or assessment credit, and students should not send requests until the posting is finalized.

parameter.title: Ethics case-note makeup lab cancellation
parameter.description: Instructor cancellation notice for the previously listed live makeup lab; no replacement meeting will be held, and the case-note work remains asynchronous.

parameter.name: Elena Duarte CCHI Mentor
parameter.organization: City Adult School Court Interpreting Certificate
parameter.notes: Directory-verified contact for optional mentor office-hours requests; use only when a current booking posting supplies a code.

parameter.content: Mentor office-hours posting: Elena Duarte has one optional credential-readiness portfolio slot on Thu Jan 22, 6:40-7:00 PM, remote. Use the directory-verified mentor address with code DUARTE-PORTFOLIO-3 by 3:30 PM today; no fee, no attendance credit, and no legal case details.

parameter.subject: Visiting mentor roster locked
parameter.body: The Duarte office-hours roster was exported at 3:30 PM. No additional requests can be added for the Jan. 22 block; students who did not receive a confirmation may watch for future optional mentor postings.
